name: Dynatrace
credentialNote: The trace get command also needs a platform token, sent only to the platform URL

supported.api: Environment API v2 and the Grail storage query API v1
supported.note: The classic commands call Environment API v2 (/api/v2) on SaaS and Managed; trace get needs the platform Grail query API (/platform/storage/query/v1), so a deployment without the platform can't run it. No release has been verified yet.
